command: pre-registration of the shared / cross-fitted fold test

arms.dimshared_all: borrowing every frame + the shared_all fold in the task's own windows
arms.dimshared_xfit: borrowing every frame + the fold of the OTHER group

metrics.bytes: a shared fold is charged once for the tasks that use it (amortised per task); programs per task
metrics.evaluation: init states 30-49, 20 episodes, paired; tasks where the prior's practice fails

folds.shared_all: rank 2, last two layers (258 KB), trained on the contact windows of all 19 grasping held-out tasks
folds.xfit_A: the same, trained on group A = 36,39,42,1,34,37,40,52,53,62 and applied to group B
folds.xfit_B: trained on group B = 3,4,5,32,41,43,48,58,63 and applied to group A

hypotheses.S1: dimshared_all non-inferior to per-task folds (dimfold_s1_last2) at -0.10 over the 19 tasks
hypotheses.S2: dimshared_xfit non-inferior to per-task folds at -0.10 (a new task needs no new weights)
hypotheses.S3: both non-inferior to the per-task LoRA at -0.10

metrics.question: can one fold serve many tasks (consolidation), and can a NEW task reuse a fold trained on other tasks (zero new weights)?
